---
title: preprocessing.coverage.assert_frontier_fresh
---



```python
preprocessing.coverage.assert_frontier_fresh(index, required_last)
```

Raise `CoverageError` if the data frontier is stale.

Corresponds to the first guard in the operational ``assert_coverage``
(script line ~457): ``index.max() < required_last`` means no new data has
arrived since the required cutoff and forecasting would extrapolate into
a data void.

The comparison is strict (``<``): ``index.max() == required_last`` is a
passing boundary (data is exactly as fresh as required).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type                                                   | Description                                                                                                                                                      | Default    |
|---------------|--------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| index         | [pd](`pandas`).[DatetimeIndex](`pandas.DatetimeIndex`) | DatetimeIndex of the interim data frame whose maximum timestamp is compared against the freshness requirement.                                                   | _required_ |
| required_last | [pd](`pandas`).[Timestamp](`pandas.Timestamp`)         | Minimum acceptable value for ``index.max()``.  Callers typically pass ``today - pd.Timedelta(hours=1)`` (the last publishable complete UTC hour before ``now``). | _required_ |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                                                           | Description                                                                                    |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [CoverageError](`spotforecast2_safe.exceptions.CoverageError`) | When ``index.max() < required_last``, naming both the observed maximum and the required value. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}


::: {#28c3e04d .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
from spotforecast2_safe.preprocessing.coverage import assert_frontier_fresh
from spotforecast2_safe.exceptions import CoverageError

# Passing: index reaches the required timestamp.
idx = pd.date_range("2026-06-10 00:00", periods=24, freq="h", tz="UTC")
required = pd.Timestamp("2026-06-10 00:00", tz="UTC")
assert_frontier_fresh(idx, required)   # no exception

# Failing: data ends one hour before the requirement.
try:
    assert_frontier_fresh(idx, pd.Timestamp("2026-06-10 23:00", tz="UTC"))
except CoverageError as exc:
    print(exc)
```
:::
